header: How to reach the Vienna studio
subheadline: Workshops, onboarding sessions and project kick-offs take place at the webconsulting studio at Lindengasse 12, one street north of Mariahilfer Strasse.

routes.description: Take the U3 to Neubaugasse. Walk north up Neubaugasse, turn right into Lindengasse and walk to number 12, just past Kirchengasse.
From the A1, follow signs for Zentrum and leave at the Gürtel. The paid Gerngross car park at Lindengasse 17 is across the street from our entrance.
From the main hall, walk east along Mariahilfer Strasse and turn left into Kirchengasse. Turn right into Lindengasse. The walk takes about 20 minutes.
